reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but takeover duplicates unlink cleanup and DbAccount repeats the existing BankSyncProviders union.

duplication.why: The shared eligibility helper centralizes linking rules, but the diff duplicates local unlink cleanup and the existing transaction-download workflow.

placement.why: Changes follow the existing account, sync, configuration and model layers, although a helper named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked now also performs unlink mutations.

scope.why: The changes remain focused on the requested linking rules, takeover option and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and linking limit divergence, but duplicated unlink state transitions and a validation helper with mutation responsibilities make future changes harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked repeats unlinkAccount's local cleanup instead of extracting a shared local unlink operation that both paths can use without provider disconnection.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing provider download workflow into compact request and response expressions while retaining its token lookup, POST, error conversion and response mapping.

abstraction_drift.where: accounts/app.ts: the shared eligibility helper accumulates closed-account rejection, duplicate-link rejection and takeover mutation, adding replaceExistingLink; all six provider link handlers call it.
